svg.title: From upload to reviewed and reconciled
svg.desc: An upload is answered with 202 at once. A background job reads the document. A clean document is processed; one that cannot be settled pauses, saved in Postgres, until a person approves, corrects or rejects it. A settled invoice can then be reconciled with its quote.
svg.text: From upload to reviewed and reconciled
Five endpoints. The slow work happens after the answer, and a paused review survives a server restart.
1 The request is answered at once
